2: A psalm. A song. For the Sabbath day. It is good to give thanks to Yahweh, and to sing praise concerning your name, O Most High;
3: to declare in the morning your loyal love and your faithfulness in the night,
4: on the ten string, and on the harp, with a melody on the lyre.
5: For you, O Yahweh, have made me glad by your work; by the deeds of your hands I sing for joy.
6: How great are your deeds, O Yahweh; how very deep are your thoughts.
7: The brutish man does not know, and the fool cannot understand this.
8: When the wicked flourish like grass and all the workers of evil blossom, it is so they can be destroyed forever.
9: But you are on high forever, O Yahweh.
10: For behold, your enemies, O Yahweh, for behold, your enemies will perish. All the workers of evil will be scattered.
11: But you have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; you have anointed me with fresh oil.
12: And so my eye looks on my enemies. My ears hear those evildoers who rise up against me.
13: The righteous will flourish like the date palm. They will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
14: Planted in the house of Yahweh, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
15: They will still prosper in old age. They will be fat and luxuriant,
16: to declare that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no injustice in him.
